name: com.duoku.platform.single.view.DKPrevtAdcateActivity
description: Duoku's anti-addiction service opens this screen when age or play-time rules block game entry. It handles real-name results and lets the SDK resume or close the game.
disableEffect: Required age and anti-addiction checks can be bypassed or left incomplete, and the game may not be allowed to continue through the Duoku platform.
